# Synthetic PDF preview fixtures

Generated by `generate_previews.py` with ReportLab (development fixture generation
only). Portrait, landscape and rotated pages contain synthetic text and fine
vector rules; a red lower region/second page detects incorrect page/crop choice.
No document from an account or user screenshot is used.

`preview-strip.png` is the portrait fixture's first 768×320 pixels rendered by
the production `pdf_preview::render` path (Poppler). The demo and native UI
benchmark use it to check actual PDF text and line detail inside document cards.
